title: Spotting Fake Internships & Digital Arrest Scams

scenes.voiceover: Two cyber scams every student should know.
scenes.visual_intent: Two incoming alerts: internship offer and suspicious official-looking call

scenes.voiceover: A dream internship arrives by message. Great pay, immediate selection, then an upfront registration fee. That's a warning sign. Check the recruiter independently.
scenes.visual_intent: Fictional recruiter chat shows attractive job offer, then fee and urgency warning

scenes.voiceover: Another caller claims to be police. They threaten a so-called digital arrest and demand your details. An official-looking call alone proves nothing.
scenes.visual_intent: Fictional video call with generic anonymous avatar and intimidation demand

scenes.voiceover: Both scams use pressure. Don't share OTPs, passwords or bank details. Pause, and check official contact information yourself.
scenes.visual_intent: Two scams point to the same pressure technique, then a safety checklist

scenes.voiceover: Report suspected cybercrime at cybercrime.gov.in. For financial cyber fraud, call 1930 promptly.
scenes.visual_intent: Separate high-contrast website reporting card and financial-fraud helpline card

scenes.voiceover: Take a moment. Verify before you trust.
scenes.visual_intent: Clear closing shield and concise memorable verification message
Minimal end card with reporting information and exact lab AI disclosure
